patterns: APPSC asks AP data one-liners: AP foodgrain output in a given year (157.59 lakh t 2017-18), and trend statements (steady increase 2019-20 to 2024-25).
Other PSCs ask leading-state items (pulses = MP; foodgrains = UP) and India's global rank (largest in milk, pulses, spices).
Scheme/mission identifications recur: Yellow Revolution = oilseeds/mustard; NFSM coverage and objectives; Tilhan Mission = oilseeds.
App MCQs lean on very recent Survey figures (FY26, Q1 FY27, 2025-26 2nd AE) and El Nino/climate percentages - more volatile than PYQs.
